questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Plasmodium vivax?
options: Asexual parasites and gametocytes in peripheral blood; thick and thin films serve different purposes.
Operculated fluke eggs in a stool wet mount.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Giardia cysts with four nuclei in a stool preparation.
questions.explanation: Asexual parasites and gametocytes in peripheral blood; thick and thin films serve different purposes. Giemsa thick films support detection; thin films preserve erythrocytes for identification, typically at 1000× oil immersion.
